texts.name: Vinrael
texts.biography: Vinrael has two attributes that make him valuable to the Elves - he is unusually observant, and he has seen more hours of battle than any other Sylvan warrior. His keen eyes, and those of his falcons, rove constantly before, during, and after a battle, studying all the elements of troops, tactics, and terrain. Analyzing both his own and the enemy's actions, he learns enormously from both sides' successes and errors.

specialty.name: Learning
specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Learning skill percentage.
